# pcd_identity_inherit_role_assignment (Resource)

Assigns an *inherited* role to a user or group: the role applies to every current and future project in a domain (or to every project below a project), but not to the domain or project itself. This is what the PCD UI's "Domain-Level Access" creates, for users and for SSO groups alike (Keystone's OS-INHERIT `inherited_to_projects` grant). For a role on the domain or project itself, use `pcd_identity_role_assignment`.

A domain-wide grant reaches every project in the domain, including projects other configurations or the PCD UI manage. Assignments are immutable: any change forces a new resource. Replacing one create-before-destroy with the same role, actor and target (unchanged arguments, for example `terraform apply -replace` under that lifecycle setting, or only `region` changed, since Keystone is global) leaves the grant revoked, because the old object's destroy removes the same grant the new object just made; the next apply restores it. Exactly one of `user_id`/`group_id` and exactly one of `domain_id`/`project_id` must be set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The PCD UI's "Domain-Level Access": alice gets the member role on every
# project in the Default domain, including projects created later.
data "pcd_identity_domain" "default" {
  name = "Default"
}

data "pcd_identity_role" "member" {
  name = "member"
}

data "pcd_identity_user" "alice" {
  name = "alice@example.com"
}

resource "pcd_identity_inherit_role_assignment" "example" {
  domain_id = data.pcd_identity_domain.default.id
  user_id   = data.pcd_identity_user.alice.id
  role_id   = data.pcd_identity_role.member.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) The role to assign.

### Optional

- `domain_id` (String) The domain whose projects inherit the role (mutually exclusive with `project_id`).
- `group_id` (String) The group to assign the role to (mutually exclusive with `user_id`).
- `project_id` (String) The project whose subprojects inherit the role (mutually exclusive with `domain_id`).
- `region` (String) The region whose identity endpoint the provider uses; Keystone is global. Defaults to the provider's region. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `user_id` (String) The user to assign the role to (mutually exclusive with `group_id`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID: `domain_id/project_id/group_id/user_id/role_id`, the same form as `pcd_identity_role_assignment`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax. The IDs are assigned by PCD; the
[Importing guide](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/platform9/pcd/latest/docs/guides/importing)
explains how to look them up.

```shell
# pcdctl role assignment list --names --inherited shows the grant; resolve each part with
#   pcdctl domain list, project list, group list, user list, and role list.
#   Leave the parts the grant does not use empty (a user on a domain: <domain_id>///<user_id>/<role_id>).
terraform import pcd_identity_inherit_role_assignment.example <domain_id>/<project_id>/<group_id>/<user_id>/<role_id>
```
